lessons.title: Series Completion
lessons.concept: Find the pattern in number/letter series and predict the next term. Common patterns: arithmetic, geometric, squares, cubes, alternating, +n, ×n.
lessons.formula: Detect rule → apply to last term

lessons.title: Analogy
lessons.concept: A:B :: C:D — relationship between A and B matches C and D. Types: synonym, antonym, part-whole, cause-effect, worker-tool.
lessons.formula: A is to B as C is to D
mistakes: Matching by category instead of relationship

lessons.title: Syllogism
lessons.concept: Draw conclusion from two premises using Venn diagrams. Universal/particular, affirmative/negative.
lessons.formula: All A are B; All B are C → All A are C
lessons.worked_example: All men are mortal. Socrates is a man. → Socrates is mortal.

practice.question: Continue: A2B4C6D8E_
practice.explanation: Letter increases, number increases by 2: A2 B4 C6 D8 E10 → next F10? Pattern: A2,B4,C6,D8,E10,F12... Actually shown as A2B4C6D8E_ → letter E with number 10 → E10, then F12. Given options, B) 10F means number then letter. The series alternates letter,number: A2 B4 C6 D8 E10 → next should be F12 but option B is 10F (reversed). The intended: E then 10 → but options show 10F. Best match: B (10F continues number-letter alternation if read as pairs).

practice.question: Odd one out: Hockey, Football, Cricket, Ludo, Tennis
practice.explanation: Ludo is a board game; others are outdoor field sports.

questions.question: Raju: "That girl playing carrom is the younger of the two daughters of my father's wife." Who is Raju referring to?
questions.explanation: Father's wife = mother. Younger of two daughters of mother = Raju's sister.

questions.question: Hand : Glove :: Foot : ?
questions.explanation: Glove covers hand; sock covers foot.

questions.question: All men are mortal. Socrates is a man. Conclusion?
questions.explanation: Syllogism: All A are B; Socrates is A → Socrates is B.
